Method of Attack: Requests users to whitelist its process against Android Doze power saving module to stay connected to its command and control (C&C) servers and continue malicious behavior
Bypasses Android's Doze component to remain alive on Android 6.0 Marshmallow
Uses permission REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS classified as normal to avoid OS warnings
Requires user to manually remove app from Doze battery power saving whitelist to disable
Impacted Systems: Android 6.0 Marshmallow and later Android versions
Attack Vector: Permission request to ignore battery optimizations (REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS)
Indicators of Compromise: Presence in Battery Optimization whitelist in Android settings
